project_type: Full-stack education platform: FastAPI backend + Cloudflare Workers edge + React SPA frontend with SSR prerendering
build_system: pnpm monorepo, pip for backend, wrangler for edge deploy
build_command: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. Run tsc --noEmit on edge package for TS validation. 2. Run pytest on backend. 3. Verify new files exist and have correct structure.
setup_instructions: 1. pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile 2. pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt (stripped hashes)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. No Docker daemon likely available in sandbox.
contribution_requirements: Branch from main, create feature branch feat/seo-optimization-v2
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI routers in app/api/v1/, registered in main.py with include_router. Tests in apps/backend/tests/ using pytest + httpx AsyncClient fixture. Edge: TypeScript routes in apps/edge/src/routes/, integrated in index.ts. Frontend: prerender scripts in apps/frontend/scripts/, React components in src/components/
directory_structure: apps/backend/ (FastAPI), apps/edge/ (CF Worker), apps/frontend/ (React SPA + SSR prerender scripts), .github/workflows/ (CI/CD)
